profile:
COMPANY NAME: Backblaze
INDUSTRY: Cloud Storage / Data Infrastructure
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: High-performance cloud storage solutions, including S3-compatible object storage (B2), premium high-throughput storage (B2 Overdrive), and specialized storage for AI workloads and neoclouds.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: AI developers, neoclouds, enterprise organizations, content creators, and businesses requiring backup, archive, or high-throughput data storage.
PRICING MODEL: Freemium / Usage-based (Offers "Start Free" and "Contact Sales" for enterprise; emphasizes predictable economics and free egress)
KEY FEATURES:
- S3-compatible object storage with no S3 limits
- High-throughput capabilities (up to 1Tbps) for AI and data-heavy workloads
- Free egress fees to eliminate unpredictable costs
- Multi-exabyte scale support with reliable HDD-based infrastructure
- Integration flexibility across clouds and tech stacks without vendor lock-in
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS:
- Eliminates hyperscaler egress fees
- Delivers high performance (terabit speeds) without compromising on cost
- Predictable pricing and economics
- Specialized solutions for AI workloads and neocloud platform expansion
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Developer-focused / Performance-oriented
